events.title: Demo launch for Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Steam Next fest is here and with it, the demo! After last Halloween it's amazing to see how much the community has grown and how far the game has come. This will be chance for you to get a feel of the game, it's atmosphere, combat and more!This is a pre alpha demo so things will change and improve overtime.
